many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

import os,re

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

def solve(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    colors=sorted(set(x for r in gi for x in r if x))
    ci={c:list(comps(gi,c)) for c in colors}
    order=sorted(colors,key=lambda c:min(min(q[1] for q in pc) for pc in ci[c]))
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    cur=0
    for c in order:
        pcs=[list(cp) for cp in ci[c]]
        desc=sorted(pcs,key=lambda pc:-len(pc))
        tops=[]; tbot=H-1
        for pc in desc:
            h_=max(p[0] for p in pc)-min(p[0] for p in pc)+1
            tops.append(tbot); tbot-=h_-1
        blk_w=max(max(q[1] for q in pc) for pc in pcs)-min(min(q[1] for q in pc) for pc in pcs)+1
        for top,pc in zip(tops,desc):
            mr=min(q[0] for q in pc); mc=min(q[1] for q in pc)
            for y,x in pc:
                rr=top+y-mr; cc=cur+x-mc
                out[rr][cc]=c
        cur+=blk_w+1
    return out

def solve(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    colors=sorted(set(x for r in gi for x in r if x))
    ci={c:[list(cp) for cp in comps(gi,c)] for c in colors}
    mcol={c:min(min(q[1] for q in pc) for pc in ci[c]) for c in colors}
    order=sorted(colors,key=lambda c:mcol[c])
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    cur=0
    for c in order:
        pcs=[list(cp) for cp in ci[c]]
        # vertical: stack largest-first, bottom anchored at H-1, 1 blank row between pieces
        desc=sorted(pcs,key=lambda pc:-len(pc))
        tops=[]; b=H-1
        for pc in desc:
            h_=max(q[0] for q in pc)-min(q[0] for q in pc)+1
            tops.append(b-h_+1); b-=h_+1
        widths=[max(q[1] for q in pc)-min(q[1] for q in pc)+1 for pc in pcs]
        blk_w=max(widths)
        # horizontal: test placements; default guess: flush left
        base=cur
        for top,pc in zip(tops,desc):
            mr=min(q[0] for q in pc); mc=min(q[1] for q in pc)
            for y,x in pc:
                rr=top+y-mr; cc=base+x-mc
                assert 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W
                out[rr][cc]=c
        cur+=blk_w+1
    return out

def solve(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    colors=sorted(set(x for r in gi for x in r if x))
    ci={c:[list(cp) for cp in comps(gi,c)] for c in colors}
    mcol={c:min(min(q[1] for q in pc) for pc in ci[c]) for c in colors}
    order=sorted(colors,key=lambda c:mcol[c])
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    cur=0
    for c in order:
        pcs=[list(cp) for cp in ci[c]]
        desc=sorted(pcs,key=len,reverse=True)   # largest at bottom
        hts=[max(q[0] for q in pc)-min(q[0] for q in pc)+1 for pc in desc]
        n=len(desc)
        tops=[]; b=H-1
        for h_ in hts[::-1]:          # bottom-up placement
            t=b-h_+1; tops.append(t); b=t-1
        w=max(max(q[1] for q in pc)-min(q[1] for q in pc)+1 for pc in desc)
        base=cur
        for t,pc in zip(tops,reversed(desc)):
            mr=min(q[0] for q in pc); mc=min(q[1] for q in pc)
            for y,x in pc:
                rr=t+y-mr; cc=base+x-mc
                assert 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W
                out[rr][cc]=c
        cur+=w+1
    return out
for nm in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    pred=solve(G[nm+' input']); exp=G[nm+' output']
    print(nm,'MATCH' if pred==exp else 'MISMATCH')
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

def solve(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    colors=sorted(set(x for r in gi for x in r if x))
    ci={c:[list(cp) for cp in comps(gi,c)] for c in colors}
    mcol={c:min(min(q[1] for q in pc) for pc in ci[c]) for c in colors}
    order=sorted(colors,key=lambda c:mcol[c])
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    cur=0
    for c in order:
        pcs=[list(cp) for cp in ci[c]]
        desc=sorted(pcs,key=len,reverse=True)   # largest at bottom
        n=len(desc)
        heights=[max(q[0] for q in pc)-min(q[0] for q in pc)+1 for pc in desc]
        # positions: bottom piece ends at H-1, one empty row between consecutive pieces
        pos=[]
        for h in heights[::-1]:            # from bottom piece up
            pos.append((H-1-h+1)); 
            Htemp=H-1-h; Htemp-=1 if pos and True else 0
        # redo: stack from bottom
        p=H-1
        for h in reversed(heights):
            t=p-h+1; pos.append(t); p=t-1
        w=max(max(q[1] for q in pc)-min(q[1] for q in pc)+1 for pc in desc)
        for t,pc in zip(pos,desc):
            mr=min(q[0] for q in pc); mc=min(q[1] for q in pc)
            for y,x in pc:
                rr=t+y-mr; cc=cur+x-mc
                assert 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W
                out[rr][cc]=c
        cur+=w+1
    return out

def solve(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    colors=sorted(set(x for r in gi for x in r if x))
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    cur=0
    for c in colors:
        pcs=comps(gi,c)
        big=max(pcs,key=len)
        others=[p for p in pcs if p is not big]
        hts=[max(q[0] for q in p)-min(q[0] for q in p)+1 for p in [big]+others]
        # bottom-up stacking: biggest bottom-anchored at H-1, others above with 1 blank row
        p=H-1
        tops=[]
        for h_ in hts[::-1]:         # smallest first -> top
            t=p-h_+1; tops.append(t); p=t-2   # one blank row
        w=max(max(q[1] for q in p)-min(q[1] for q in p)+1 for p in pcs)
        base=cur
        for t,pc in zip(tops,reversed([big]+others)):
            mr=min(q[0] for q in pc); mc=min(q[1] for q in pc)
            for y,x in pc:
                rr=t+y-mr; cc=base+x-mc
                assert 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W
                out[rr][cc]=c
        cur+=w+1
    return out

def solve(gi,key,verbose=False):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    colors=sorted(set(x for r in gi for x in r if x))
    mcol={c:min(min(q[1] for q in pc) for pc in comps(gi,c)) for c in colors}
    order=sorted(colors,key=lambda c:mcol[c]); cur=0; out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for c in order:
        pcs=comps(gi,c); n=sorted(pcs,key=key)
        b=H-1
        for i,p in enumerate(n):
            mr=min(q[0] for q in p); mc=min(q[1] for q in p)
            h_=max(q[0] for q in p)-mr+1
            t=b-h_+1
            if verbose: print(' color',c,'keyval',key(p),'size',len(p),'placed rows',t,t+h_-1)
            for y,x in p:
                out[t+y-mr][cur+x-mc]=c
            if i<len(n)-1: b=t-2
        cur+=max(max(q[1] for q in p)-min(q[1] for q in p)+1 for p in pcs)+1
    return out

def solve(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    colors=sorted(set(x for r in gi for x in r if x))
    mcol={c:min(min(q[1] for q in pc) for pc in comps(gi,c)) for c in colors}
    order=sorted(colors,key=lambda c:mcol[c]); cur=0
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for c in order:
        pcs=comps(gi,c); big=max(pcs,key=len); small=[p for p in pcs if p!=big][0]
        hb=max(q[0] for q in big)-min(q[0] for q in big)+1; sb=max(q[0] for q in small)-min(q[0] for q in small)+1
        tb=H-hb; tsb=tb-hs-1-1 if False else None
        # anchor big at bottom: t_b = H-hb ... set bottom row of big = H-1 => t = H-hb
        def place(p,t):
            mr=min(q[0] for q in p); mc=min(q[1] for q in p)
            for y,x in p: out[t+y-mr][cur+x-mc]=c
        place(big,tb); place(small,tb-hb-sb-1)
        cur+=max(max(q[1] for q in p)-min(q[1] for q in p)+1 for p in pcs)+1
    return out
for nm in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
